title: Ambiguous
overview: Mahim and his friend arrive at a quiet location for a routine task, but things turn unsettling when Mahim sees a strange man holding a red piece of paper—someone his friend cannot see. The figure vanishes, leaving behind coordinates that pull them into the unknown. Curious, they follow it and are suddenly transported to an abandoned place beyond reality. Separated and disoriented, Mahim experiences disturbing events: cryptic messages, unexplained calls, and traces of a hidden system that seems to categorize human lives. As he searches for his friend, he discovers a horrifying mechanism that selects and consumes its victims. Worse, escaping it doesn’t mean freedom—time itself begins to distort, pushing him toward an inevitable end. Trapped between illusion and reality, Mahim must face a fate that may already be decided. Some mysteries are better left unsolved.
